headline: Audit to FP&A (tech)

current.work: Conducts financial statement audits for clients at a mid-size public accounting firm — reviewing financial records for accuracy and compliance, and explaining findings to clients.
strengths: Comfortable working with real company financials under scrutiny
Strong at explaining numbers clearly to clients

target.work: Embedded within one company, building budgets and forecasts, financial modeling, and presenting numbers to internal leadership

goalInTheirWords: I want out of accounting - burnt out on the billable-hours grind and busy season. FP&A jumps out at me - I like the idea of being embedded at one company, especially something in tech, and not dealing with client billing anymore.
restatedGoal: Move from public accounting audit into an FP&A analyst role at a tech company, ready to start interviewing within about 9 months.
motivation: Burnt out on billable hours and busy season; wants a steadier internal role where she still gets to explain numbers to people, just without client billing.
successLooksLike: Landing an FP&A analyst role at a tech company, working on internal budgeting and forecasting instead of client audits.
deadline: Start interviewing within about 9 months (roughly June 2027)
startingPoint: Strong accounting and financial statement foundation from audit; no formal financial modeling or forecasting experience yet
pastAttempts: None - first time trying to switch careers
